Class CoursesByCategory

java.lang.Object
org.codewithmagret.model.CoursesByCategory
public class CoursesByCategory extends Object
This class represents a report of courses grouped by category. It contains the category name and the number of courses in that category. It is used as a Data Transfer Object (DTO) to transfer data from the service layer

  • Field Details

    • categoryId

      public Long categoryId
      The ID of the category. This field is used to identify the category and is typically a unique identifier in the database.

    • categoryName

      public String categoryName
      The name of the category. This field is used to provide a human-readable name for the category, which can be displayed in the UI or reports.

    • courses

      public List<SimpleCourse> courses
      The list of courses in the category. This field contains the courses that belong to the category, allowing us to see which courses are grouped under each category.
